finding: The reader compiled against initial global syscall hooks uses later replacement hooks. Tail delegation preserves immediate caller, arity, handle and buffer aliases; replacing a request slot preserves the caller scalar.
limits: Pure language-mechanism support only. No real descriptor, lower-reader cleanup, release fixture, native proxy or integrated observer is qualified by this probe.
scope: Only the four synthetic sysread/sysopen calls are counted by real_syscalls=0. They execute inert hooks, never CORE sysread/sysopen. This is not a syscall census of Perl startup, Test::More, the RAM guard or the host.
